segments.title: How old can this river fish get?
segments.say: A plain river fish. How old can it get? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: 131 YEARS old!
segments.say: One hundred thirty one years! Older than anyone alive today.

segments.title: The old record? Just 61
segments.say: The old record was just sixty one.

segments.title: The catch: few young fish
segments.say: But fewer young ones are joining.
Follow for Guess It number 35 tonight.
